description: This file defines the LocalizationPartHandler class, which manages localization-related behaviors for content parts within OrchardCore CMS, including creation, publishing, unpublishing, removal, and cloning of localization parts.

classes.name: LocalizationPartHandler
classes.description: Handles localization-related events for LocalizationPart, including creation, content item aspect retrieval, publishing, unpublishing, removal, and cloning.

methods.name: CreatingAsync
methods.description: Initializes LocalizationPart properties during content creation, generating a new LocalizationSet ID if missing and setting default culture if not specified.

methods.name: GetContentItemAspectAsync
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the CultureAspect based on the LocalizationPart's culture information.

methods.name: PublishedAsync
methods.description: Updates localization entries after content is published if LocalizationSet and Culture are set.

methods.name: UnpublishedAsync
methods.description: Updates localization entries after content is unpublished if LocalizationSet and Culture are set.

methods.name: RemovedAsync
methods.description: Updates localization entries after content is removed if LocalizationSet and Culture are set and no active version remains.

methods.name: CloningAsync
methods.description: Resets the LocalizationSet of a cloned LocalizationPart to an empty string.
